solution.text:
The system of linear equations is:
$$
\begin{aligned}
&x+y+z=2 \\
&2 x+y-z=3 \\
&3 x+2 y+k z=4
\end{aligned}
$$
As, system has unique solution.
$$
\begin{aligned}
&\text { So, }\left|\begin{array}{ccc}
1 & 1 & 1 \\
2 & 1 & -1 \\
3 & 2 & k
\end{array}\right| \neq 0 \\
&\Rightarrow k+2-(2 k+3)+1 \neq 0 \\
&\Rightarrow k \neq 0
\end{aligned}
$$
Hence, $k \in R-\{0\} \equiv S$
